title: [E12-12] Controllable Physical Vibration Reminders
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E12-12 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/13

**User Story:**
As a wearable participant, I want a physical vibration reminder I can stop, so prompts are nonintrusive and controllable.

**Epic:** E12 — Optional wearable safety, firmware & privacy  
**Domain:** IoT firmware / Local companion / Privacy  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 3 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Firmware/Privacy  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-032  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E12`, `iot-firmware`, `local-companion`, `privacy`, `hardware-dependent`

**Dependencies:** [E12-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/162), [E12-13](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/163)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: E12-11, E12-13; additional proposed blockers: None.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Vibration triggers only under configured conditions; dismiss, cooldown, device reset and motor failure behaviors tested.
- [ ] Trigger motor only from validated configured activity-state transitions.
- [ ] Provide participant dismiss/disable and enforce cooldown to avoid repeated vibration.
- [ ] Define power-on/reset behavior so unexpected pulses are avoided.
- [ ] Detect or document observable motor/driver failure and retain functioning stop controls.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use suitable motor driver/power wiring and a bounded nonblocking actuator routine; software simulation is labeled separately.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Trigger real motor, dismiss, hold activity through cooldown and reset; record observed timing and failure behavior.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
